no longer drop on hold, ticket alerts wait for working hours, every ticket has a team, calls reach agents working on emails, and better chat flows and chat AI.

Hold: a customer put on hold now hears the hold music the whole time and the call stays up. Before, the customer was sent silence and their network hung up about 30 seconds into the hold.

Ticket alerts in working hours: alerts about tickets (a customer waiting for a reply, a ticket reopened, escalated, overdue or at risk of missing its service level) are emailed between 08:00 and 17:00 in your organisation's time zone; one raised at night is emailed at 08:00. They still show under the bell at once, and urgent alerts such as major incidents still go out straight away.

Every ticket has a team: a ticket saved without a team, including those made from email, takes its queue's team, else the team its assignee joined most recently. A team chosen by a person always stands. "No team" in the ticket monitor and reports now only means the assignee is in no team.

Calls while working on emails: an agent with emails open is now offered calls; an open chat, WhatsApp, SMS or social message still keeps calls away. Whatever an agent has typed in a reply, on any channel, is kept as a draft on that conversation or ticket in their browser and is there when they come back after the call.

Service level drill-down: the calls behind the service level are listed in two groups, those that missed it first and those that met it, each with its count. The agent card shows calls taken apart from other work. Service-level breaches today now drill by channel first, then queue and agent.

Agent desk: no more accidental hang-ups, as banners no longer move the call buttons, Hang up is in one place and a click in the instant the screen changes is ignored; each hang-up records how it happened. Recent shows missed calls with Call back, or who answered them instead. Agent assist leads the right-hand column and stays in view on a call.

Chat flows: the editor uses chat wording, the AI step can route by need with intents that match your queue names, and text on the canvas no longer overlaps. The web chat widget preview stays inside its frame.

Chat AI: when the AI cannot answer it now says so and hands over instead of looping silently; it does the look-up it promised instead of ending on "let me check"; and when it says it is getting a colleague it hands over with what the customer said. The widget header shows your uploaded icon.

Fixes: an AI agent set to one language always listens in that language; the email service-level clock follows the receiving address's opening hours when the policy and queue have none; the AI dashboard covers every AI provider; the voice picker searches by name, language or accent; durations of an hour or more read hours:minutes:seconds; Reports and Dashboards tabs share one width and one tab strip, with Executive insights in the Reports group; Find a screen finds Service levels for "SLA"; and the server capacity forecast reads the right disk."}
